# STIX 2.1 JSON schemas

These files are the OASIS `cti-stix2-json-schemas` branch `stix2.1` at
`c4f8d589acf2bdb3783655c89e0ffb6e150006ae`. They are vendored so
`stix2-validator` can check export bundles without a network call. The PyPI
wheel of `stix2-validator` 3.3.1 does not ship this schema submodule.

The schema files are unchanged. `LICENSE` is the OASIS BSD licence.
